description: Captures the deterministic transition into the E1 finale screen after E1M9 completion (or the shareware end-of-episode after E1M8): F_StartFinale entry, F_TextWrite scrolling text rate (~3 tics per character), the F_BUNNY_SCROLLRATE (640 pixels over 105 tics during E1 cast call), and the framebuffer/state captures at finale entry, text-write end, and cast-call sequence end.
captureMethod: Run scripted full E1 path to the finale; capture state + framebuffer at finale-entry, text-write end (~280 tics for E1 text), and post-cast-call.
